messages:
Asha (CSM): Quick heads up — Stratiform wants to pay via PO for the renewal and extend term to 15 months at current rate. They said they need vendor code + VAT/tax id on the SOW. Can finance confirm we can accept a PO and what we need on our side?
Tom (Finance): We can accept PO. Need vendor_code, vendor_tax_id, PO number, and bill-to entity. Net30 is fine unless legal flags otherwise.
Priya (Legal): Also need confirmation of signer authority (delegated sign?) and that PO references the correct legal entity name. If PO references a different entity, we need a short SOW redline. VAT clause for EU needs to be present.
Jorge (Stratiform): Hey team — yes, we'll switch to PO. Vendor code: STRAT-987654. Tax/VAT: GB999999777. We'll attach PO tomorrow AM. Can you send updated SOW with vendor info and line items?
Asha (CSM): Thanks Jorge. I'll draft the amended SOW with vendor fields and 15mo term. Tom — can you confirm mapping for vendor code STRAT-987654 in AP and the account code we should use?
Tom (Finance): Confirmed STRAT-987654 maps to vendor record V-1987. Use account code RENEW-STRAT. One ask: AP needs invoice lines to reference the PO number exactly. Also, billing@redwood.com must receive signed SOW + PO PDF to create the invoice.
Priya (Legal): If customer signs via delegated signer, we need a statement of authority on the PO or a separate delegation letter. If they can't provide, we should accept for now but add an acceptance clause. I'll attach a 1-line redline to the SOW.
Asha (CSM): Uploading draft SOW here: https://docsend.com/s/stratiform-sow-draft  — small snippet below for AP: 
```
Invoice lines:
- Redwood Inference — Renewal (15 months) — Qty 1 — USD 120,000 — PO: <PO_NUMBER>
- Deployment & Onboarding Credit — USD 0 (included)
```
Jorge (Stratiform): PO #PO-4521 — attaching now (sending via email). We will have the authorized signatory sign.
Asha (CSM): Got PO #PO-4521. Priya — applying your one-line redline now. docusign-bot, create envelope to Jorge + Asha once SOW updated. Targeting signature by Tue. :thumbsup:
docusign-bot: Envelope created (id: 1719754322) — recipients: Jorge (signer), Asha (cc). Link: https://docusign.com/envelope/1719754322
Tom (Finance): After signature, please send signed SOW + PO to billing@redwood.com with subject: "Invoice prep — PO-4521 — Stratiform". I'll queue it for Net30.
Asha (CSM): Will do. Closing loop here once billing confirms receipt. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
